text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Format your damn source code better!! It's 
impossible to read!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You wanna co-develop the program to 'Save 
ST-2's running form as 3D data' all the 
way to completion, right? With me!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I-I apologize... Ever since I was young, 
I've had a bad habit of writing in my own 
idiosyncratic style... I thought I had 
tidied it up somewhat, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Figures. Wrote it all in one night, 
and while the content's perfect, it 
completely sacrifices readability.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, why the hell are you standing? 
What happened to your wheelchair?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, my wheelchair is charging. Even so, 
there was something I wanted to tell you, 
so I took my time resting along the way 
here—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I checked it earlier, Shakur... Your 
source code is truly beautiful!!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Few warnings, great consistency... And 
best of all, thanks to the meticulous 
naming conventions and comments, it's so 
easy to read!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Part of it might be your personality, 
but... what is it? It's like you can 
genuinely see into the person you're 
reading—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: It is simply overflowing with kindness!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... You really came all this way just 
to tell me something that stupid? How 
bored are you...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—I'll teach you how to write it properly. 
Memorize it. And don't you ever show me 
such irritating code again.
